name: Miffy bilateral cheek-light trial v28 · non-production

faceLighting.note: Signed cheek balance: -100 darkens screen-left and softly lifts screen-right; +100 reverses them. Neutral is the untouched painting. This is an artist-directed bilateral lighting hypothesis, not recovered source normals.

limits: v27's whole-face bias is not the user's requested left/right cheek exchange; v28 removes that common bias while preserving the same pixel warp and source art.
The bright side approaches white without multiplying already pale source skin beyond its channel range; dark outlines, eyes, lips and neck remain masked or attenuated.
This is a reversible local review, not physically complete relighting, a finished head turn, or public release. Both signs and moving frames require user approval.
